# Third-party static glTF dependencies

* `cgltf/cgltf.h` is pinned at `85cd62382dfea638278962690cf515023f33ed00`
  from <https://github.com/jkuhlmann/cgltf>, under the MIT license.
* `mikktspace/` is pinned at `3e895b49d05ea07e4c2133156cfa94369e19e409`
  from <https://github.com/mmikk/MikkTSpace>, under the zlib license.

The upstream license text is retained in each vendored source file.
